```{r paths-and-options}
first_existing <- function(paths) {
  hit <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) {
    stop("None of these paths exist:\n", paste(paths, collapse = "\n"))
  }
  hit[[1]]
}
```

```{r read-and-curate-inputs}
tree <- read.tree(TREE_FILE)

metadata <- read_csv(MASTER_METADATA_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(include_final_ultrametric_tree == "yes", include_core_analyses == "yes") %>%
  transmute(
    genome_id,
    tree_label,
    species_name,
    family,
    order,
    source,
    annotation_source,
    lifestyle,
    dimorphic,
    sexual_reproduction,
    mat_locus
  )

confirmed_alias_map <- tribble(
  ~assembly_stats_id, ~genome_id,
  "Dissophora_globulifera_1448", "gzDisGlob2",
  "Mucor_flavus_VKMF1003", "gzMucFlav2",
  "Mucor_flavus_VKMF1097", "gzMucFlav3",
  "Mucor_flavus_VKMF1110", "gzMucFlav4",
  "Mucor_fragilis_CMMF236", "gzMucFrag2",
  "Mucor_fragilis_U113030", "gzMucFrag3",
  "Mucor_plumbeus_2412", "gzMucPlum3",
  "Mucor_plumbeus_4808", "gzMucPlum4",
  "Mucor_plumbeus_CCMF443", "gzMucPlum5",
  "Mucor_plumbeus_UBOCC208", "gzMucPlum6",

  left_join(confirmed_alias_map, by = "assembly_stats_id", suffix = c("", "_confirmed")) %>%
  mutate(
    genome_id = coalesce(genome_id_confirmed, genome_id, possible_genome_id),
    Busco_single_copy_part = pmax(Busco - Busco_Dup, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(
    genome_id,
    nbContig,
    totalLength_MB,
    N50_MB,
    GC,
    Busco,
    Busco_Dup,
    Busco_single_copy_part
  )

repeat_summary <- read_tsv(REPEAT_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(Species, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    genome_id = Species,
    GenomeSizeMb_repeat = Total_length_bp / 1e6,
    GC_percent_repeat = GC_percent,
    Retroelements = Retroelements_percent,
    DNA = DNA_transposons_percent + Rolling_circles_percent,
    Unknown = Unclassified_percent,
    Other = Other_percent,
    TotalRepeat = Bases_masked_percent
  )
```

```{r optional-orthofinder-stats}
read_orthofinder_species_stats <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(tibble(
      genome_id = character(),
      NumberGenes = numeric(),
      GenesInOrthogroups = numeric(),
      UnassignedGenes = numeric(),
      PercentGenesInOrthogroups = numeric(),
      SpeciesSpecificOrthogroups = numeric(),
      SpeciesSpecificGenes = numeric()
    ))
  }

  raw <- read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_names = TRUE)
  stat_col <- names(raw)[[1]]

  raw %>%
    filter(.data[[stat_col]] %in% c(
      "Number of genes",
      "Number of genes in orthogroups",
      "Number of unassigned genes",
      "Percentage of genes in orthogroups",
      "Number of species-specific orthogroups",
      "Number of genes in species-specific orthogroups"
    )) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -all_of(stat_col),
      names_to = "genome_id",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      genome_id = genome_id %>%
        str_remove("\\.proteins$") %>%
        str_remove("\\.ncbi\\.pep$") %>%
        str_remove("\\.pep$") %>%
        str_remove("_prot$") %>%
        recode(EntParv = "EntParv1"),
      value = as.numeric(value),
      statistic = recode(
        .data[[stat_col]],
        "Number of genes" = "NumberGenes",
        "Number of genes in orthogroups" = "GenesInOrthogroups",
        "Number of unassigned genes" = "UnassignedGenes",
        "Percentage of genes in orthogroups" = "PercentGenesInOrthogroups",
        "Number of species-specific orthogroups" = "SpeciesSpecificOrthogroups",
        "Number of genes in species-specific orthogroups" = "SpeciesSpecificGenes"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(genome_id, statistic, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = statistic, values_from = value)
}

orthofinder_stats <- read_orthofinder_species_stats(GENE_STATS_FILE)
```

```{r combine-data}
overview <- tibble(tree_label = tree$tip.label) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "tree_label") %>%
  mutate(genome_id = coalesce(genome_id, tree_label)) %>%
  left_join(assembly_qc, by = "genome_id") %>%
  left_join(repeat_summary, by = "genome_id") %>%
  left_join(orthofinder_stats, by = "genome_id") %>%
  mutate(
    GenomeSizeMb = coalesce(totalLength_MB, GenomeSizeMb_repeat),
    GC_percent = coalesce(GC * 100, GC_percent_repeat),
    GenomeSet = case_when(
      source == "EBPNOR" ~ "new genome",
      source == "Other" ~ "public/reference",
      is.na(source) ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ source
    ),
    TipFace = if_else(GenomeSet == "new genome", "bold", "plain"),
    SexualReproduction = case_when(
      is.na(sexual_reproduction) | sexual_reproduction == "" ~ "unknown",
      str_to_lower(sexual_reproduction) == "yes" ~ "Yes",
      str_to_lower(sexual_reproduction) == "no" ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    ),
    MatLocus = case_when(
      is.na(mat_locus) | mat_locus == "" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ mat_locus
    ),
    Lifestyle = case_when(
      is.na(lifestyle) | lifestyle == "" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ lifestyle
    ),
    Family = case_when(
      is.na(family) | family == "" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ family
    ),
    Order = case_when(
      is.na(order) | order == "" ~ "unknown",
      TRUE ~ order
    )
  )

stopifnot("MucCirc3" %in% tree$tip.label)

missing_metrics <- overview %>%
  transmute(
    tree_label,
    genome_id,
    missing_genome_size = is.na(GenomeSizeMb),
    missing_repeats = is.na(TotalRepeat),
    missing_of_gene_count = is.na(NumberGenes),
    missing_of_percent_genes_in_orthogroups = is.na(PercentGenesInOrthogroups),
    missing_of_species_specific_orthogroups = is.na(SpeciesSpecificOrthogroups),
    missing_sexual_reproduction = SexualReproduction == "unknown",
    missing_mat_locus = MatLocus == "unknown",
    missing_lifestyle = Lifestyle == "unknown"
  ) %>%
  filter(if_any(starts_with("missing_"), identity))

write_tsv(missing_metrics, OUTPUT_MISSING)
missing_metrics
```

```{r tree-order-and-backgrounds}
max_time <- max(nodeHeights(tree))
max_time_ma <- max_time * TREE_TIME_SCALE

base_tree <- ggtree(tree) +
  theme_tree2()

tip_order <- base_tree$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  arrange(y)

species_levels <- tip_order$label

overview <- overview %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(tree_label, levels = species_levels))

tip_annotation <- tip_order %>%
  select(tree_label = label, y) %>%
  left_join(overview, by = "tree_label")

group_ranges <- tip_annotation %>%
  filter(!is.na(Order), Order != "unknown") %>%
  group_by(Order) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(y) - 0.5,
    ymax = max(y) + 0.5,
    ymid = mean(range(y)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fill = recode(
      Order,
      Mucorales = "#F5DDD6",
      Umbelopsidales = "#F9E8AF",
      Mortierellales = "#D8E6F6",
      .default = "#F1F1F1"
    ),
    label_color = recode(
      Order,
      Mucorales = "#8B2E2E",
      Umbelopsidales = "#D88922",
      Mortierellales = "#4A77BF",
      .default = "#555555"
    )
  )

family_ranges <- tip_annotation %>%
  filter(!is.na(Family), Family != "unknown") %>%
  group_by(Order, Family) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(y) - 0.5,
    ymax = max(y) + 0.5,
    ymid = mean(range(y)),
    n_tips = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_color = recode(
      Order,
      Mucorales = "#8B2E2E",
      Umbelopsidales = "#D88922",
      Mortierellales = "#4A77BF",
      .default = "#555555"
    )
  )

time_bands <- tibble(
  xmin = seq(0, max_time, by = TIME_BAND_MA / TREE_TIME_SCALE),
  xmax = pmin(xmin + TIME_BAND_MA / TREE_TIME_SCALE, max_time)
) %>%
  mutate(band_id = seq_along(xmin)) %>%
  filter(band_id %% 2 == 1)

add_order_bands <- function(p) {
  p +
    geom_rect(
      data = group_ranges,
      aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = group_ranges$fill,
      alpha = 0.65
    )
}
```

```{r tree-panel}
p_tree <- base_tree %<+% overview +
  geom_rect(
    data = time_bands,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#EEF0EF",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = group_ranges,
    aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = group_ranges$fill,
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_tree(linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(fontface = TipFace),
    align = TRUE,
    linesize = 0.2,
    size = 2.7,
    offset = 0.02
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = group_ranges,
    aes(x = max_time * -0.75, y = ymid, label = Order, color = Order),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = family_ranges %>% filter(Order == "Mucorales", n_tips >= 2),
    aes(x = max_time * -0.08, y = ymid, label = Family, color = Order),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3,
    hjust = 0,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(group_ranges$label_color, group_ranges$Order),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max_time, by = TIME_BAND_MA / TREE_TIME_SCALE),
    labels = function(x) round((max_time - x) * TREE_TIME_SCALE)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(max_time * -0.8, max_time * 1.35), clip = "off") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 120, 5.5, 5.5),
    axis.title.x = element_blank()
  )

p_tree
```

```{r panel-helpers}
theme_side_panel <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

make_bar_panel <- function(data, x_col, x_label, fill = "#5D4E49") {
  add_order_bands(
    ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_col]], y = Species))
  ) +
    geom_col(fill = fill, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = NULL) +
    theme_side_panel()
}

make_tile_panel <- function(data, fill_col, x_label, values) {
  add_order_bands(
    ggplot(data, aes(x = x_label, y = Species, fill = .data[[fill_col]]))
  ) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.9, height = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = values, na.value = "white") +
    labs(x = x_label, y = NULL, fill = x_label) +
    theme_side_panel() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r panels}
p_genome <- make_bar_panel(overview, "GenomeSizeMb", "A. Genome size (Mb)", "#5D4E49")

repeat_long <- overview %>%
  transmute(
    Species,
    DNA,
    Retroelements,
    Other,
    Unknown
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Species,
    names_to = "RepeatType",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    RepeatType = factor(
      RepeatType,
      levels = c("DNA", "Retroelements", "Other", "Unknown")
    )
  )

p_repeat <- add_order_bands(
  ggplot(repeat_long, aes(x = Percent, y = Species, fill = RepeatType))
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      DNA = "#305141",
      Retroelements = "#7eba78",
      Other = "#d1f9a6",
      Unknown = "#A49B93"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "B. Repeats (%)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_side_panel() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_of_genes <- make_bar_panel(overview, "NumberGenes", "C. Genes", "#5D4E49")

p_of_orthogroup_percent <- make_bar_panel(
  overview,
  "PercentGenesInOrthogroups",
  "D. Genes in OGs (%)",
  "#5D4E49"
) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)))

p_of_species_specific <- make_bar_panel(
  overview,
  "SpeciesSpecificOrthogroups",
  "E. Species-specific OGs",
  "#5D4E49"
)

p_sex <- make_tile_panel(
  overview,
  "SexualReproduction",
  "F. Sex",
  c(
    Yes = "#7B4AB8",
    No = "#111111",
    unknown = "#D7DEE8"
  )
)

p_mat <- make_tile_panel(
  overview,
  "MatLocus",
  "MAT",
  c(
    `putatively functional` = "#305141",
    present = "#7eba78",
    partial = "#C9B46A",
    absent = "#A49B93",
    unknown = "#D7DEE8"
  )
)

p_lifestyle <- make_tile_panel(
  overview,
  "Lifestyle",
  "G. Ecology",
  c(
    saprotrophic = "#426A5A",
    `saprotrophic, endophyte` = "#6B7F44",
    `saprotrophic, opportunisitc pathogen` = "#9C6644",
    `saprotrophic, opportunisitc pathogen plants` = "#8B7E4B",
    fermentation = "#7C5E99",
    Pathogen = "#8A5A76",
    `Opportunistic pathogen` = "#B46A55",
    `arbuscular mycorrhizal` = "#4D7C7B",
    unknown = "#D7DEE8"
  )
)
```

```{r assemble-main-figure}
panel_lookup <- list(
  genome_size = p_genome,
  repeats = p_repeat,
  of_genes = p_of_genes,
  of_orthogroup_percent = p_of_orthogroup_percent,
  of_species_specific = p_of_species_specific,
  sexual_reproduction = p_sex,
  mat_locus = p_mat,
  lifestyle = p_lifestyle
)

panel_widths <- c(
  genome_size = 1,
  repeats = 1.2,
  of_genes = 1,
  of_orthogroup_percent = 1,
  of_species_specific = 1,
  sexual_reproduction = 0.32,
  mat_locus = 0.55,
  lifestyle = 0.32
)

final_plot <- panel_lookup[[SHOW_PANELS[[1]]]] %>%
  insert_left(p_tree, width = 2.7)

for (panel_name in SHOW_PANELS[-1]) {
  final_plot <- final_plot %>%
    insert_right(panel_lookup[[panel_name]], width = panel_widths[[panel_name]])
}

final_plot

ggsave(
  OUTPUT_PDF,
  final_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 12
)
```

```{r supporting-correlation}
repeat_correlation <- overview %>%
  filter(!is.na(GenomeSizeMb), !is.na(TotalRepeat))

lm_repeat <- lm(TotalRepeat ~ GenomeSizeMb, data = repeat_correlation)

p_correlation <- ggplot(
  repeat_correlation,
  aes(x = GenomeSizeMb, y = TotalRepeat)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.5,
    label = paste0(
      "Slope = ", round(coef(lm_repeat)[2], 3),
      "\nR2 = ", round(summary(lm_repeat)$r.squared, 2),
      "\nP = ", signif(coef(summary(lm_repeat))[2, 4], 2)
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome size (Mb)",
    y = "Repeat content (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_correlation
```
